description: Rename the reserved root package com.appian.mqtt to de.hock.mqtt across the whole repo (33 main sources + 1 test source + pom groupId + non-Java references), preserving all five subpackages and leaving Appian's own com.appian.connectedsystems.* / com.appiancorp.* SDK packages untouched. Appian rejects any plug-in whose packages live under com.appian.* or com.appiancorp.*, so this is a hard blocker. Must complete before FEAT-002, which writes the new fully-qualified class names into the plug-in manifest. Implements items 1-5 of .agents/tasks/appmarket-compliance-plan.md.
steps: Move the main tree: mkdir -p src/main/java/de/hock && mv src/main/java/com/appian/mqtt src/main/java/de/hock/mqtt && rm -rf src/main/java/com. All five subpackages (diagnostics, integration, protocol, template, validation) and all four package-info.java files keep their names. Confirm 33 .java files land under src/main/java/de/hock/mqtt and src/main/java/com no longer exists.
Move the test tree: mkdir -p src/test/java/de/hock && mv src/test/java/com/appian/mqtt src/test/java/de/hock/mqtt && rm -rf src/test/java/com. The only file is ProjectStructureTest.java.

Rewrite every package declaration, import, Javadoc {@link}, and string literal from com.appian.mqtt to de.hock.mqtt in all 34 moved files: grep -rl 'com\.appian\.mqtt' src/main/java src/test/java | xargs sed -i '' 's/com\.appian\.mqtt/de.hock.mqtt/g'. This literal, anchored pattern cannot match the SDK's com.appian.connectedsystems.* imports. DO NOT replace the bare string 'com.appian' anywhere.

Fix src/test/java/de/hock/mqtt/ProjectStructureTest.java by hand: basePackageIsPresent asserts basePackage.getName().startsWith("com.appian.mqtt") with the message "Tests live under the com.appian.mqtt base package" - update both the argument and the message to de.hock.mqtt. The other two tests assert appian-plugin.xml and resources_en_US.properties are on the classpath and need no change.

In pom.xml change <groupId>com.appian.mqtt</groupId> to <groupId>de.hock</groupId>. Leave <artifactId>mqtt-broker-connected-system</artifactId> and <version>1.0.0</version> alone - neither embeds the old package, so the shipped filename target/mqtt-broker-connected-system-1.0.0-plugin.jar does not change.

Fix the remaining non-Java references: the explanatory comment in src/main/resources/resources_en_US.properties that names com.appian.mqtt.validation.ConfigFields, and the single hit in .kiro/specs/mqtt-broker-connected-system/tasks.md. Leave src/main/resources/appian-plugin.xml to FEAT-002. Do NOT edit anything under .agents/ - the plan and the prior audit intentionally quote the old package name as historical record.
Verify the rename did not touch the SDK: grep -rn 'com\.appian\.connectedsystems' src/main/java must still return its original matches, and find src -type d -name appian must print nothing.
acceptance_criteria: find src/main/java -name '*.java' | wc -l returns 33 and find src/test/java -name '*.java' | wc -l returns 1, all under de/hock/mqtt/
mvn -q clean test succeeds with Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0, reported for de.hock.mqtt.ProjectStructureTest
grep -rn 'com\.appian\.mqtt\|com/appian/mqtt' src pom.xml docs info.md .kiro returns no matches
grep -rn 'com\.appian\.connectedsystems' src/main/java still returns matches - SDK imports are intact
verification: grep -rn 'com\.appian\.mqtt\|com/appian/mqtt' src pom.xml docs info.md .kiro || echo 'CLEAN'
findings:
DONE. Package rename com.appian.mqtt -> de.hock.mqtt complete; no git commands were run, all edits in place.

FILE COUNTS: src/main/java holds 33 .java files, all under src/main/java/de/hock/mqtt/ (root package + the five subpackages diagnostics/integration/protocol/template/validation, all 4 package-info.java preserved). src/test/java holds 1 .java file, src/test/java/de/hock/mqtt/ProjectStructureTest.java. Neither src/main/java/com nor src/test/java/com exists; `find src -type d -name appian` prints nothing. `ls src/main/java src/test/java` shows only `de` in each.

REWRITE: the anchored sed (grep -rl 'com\.appian\.mqtt' | xargs sed -i '' 's/com\.appian\.mqtt/de.hock.mqtt/g') matched exactly 34 files and handled 100% of the Java references - 104 de.hock.mqtt occurrences now across those 34 files. NO file needed a manual fix: step 4's ProjectStructureTest edit (startsWith("com.appian.mqtt") argument plus the "Tests live under the com.appian.mqtt base package" message) was fully covered by the same sed, verified by reading the file afterwards. Non-Java edits were done by hand: pom.xml <groupId>com.appian.mqtt</groupId> -> <groupId>de.hock</groupId> (artifactId/version untouched), the ConfigFields comment on line 9 of src/main/resources/resources_en_US.properties, and the one hit on line 12 of .kiro/specs/mqtt-broker-connected-system/tasks.md. Nothing under .agents/ was touched (DD-7).

TEST OUTPUT (export JAVA_HOME=.../amazon-corretto-17.jdk/Contents/Home && mvn clean test, network not needed, no offline fallback required): 'Compiling 33 source files with javac [debug release 17] to target/classes', 'Compiling 1 source file ... to target/test-classes', 'Running de.hock.mqtt.ProjectStructureTest', 'Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0, Time elapsed: 0.023 s -- in de.hock.mqtt.ProjectStructureTest', 'Results: Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0', BUILD SUCCESS in 3.623 s. `mvn -q help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.groupId -DforceStdout` prints `de.hock`.

SDK INTACT: com.appian.connectedsystems counts per file are byte-identical to the pre-rename baseline - MqttPublishIntegration 16, MqttSubscribeIntegration 18, MqttConnectedSystemTemplate 18, diagnostics/ResponseMapper 2, diagnostics/DiagnosticsBuilder 1 (55 total). No com.appiancorp.* reference was altered.

FOR FEAT-002 - ACCEPTANCE CRITERION 5 IS INTENTIONALLY NOT YET SATISFIED: `grep -rn 'com\.appian\.mqtt\|com/appian/mqtt' src pom.xml docs info.md .kiro` still returns exactly 4 hits, ALL in src/main/resources/appian-plugin.xml: line 22 key="com.appian.mqtt", line 32 class="com.appian.mqtt.template.MqttConnectedSystemTemplate", line 35 class="com.appian.mqtt.integration.MqttPublishIntegration", line 38 class="com.appian.mqtt.integration.MqttSubscribeIntegration". FEAT-001 step 6 and plan item 5 explicitly defer the manifest to FEAT-002/plan item 6, which conflicts with this FEAT's own criterion 5; the step instruction was followed and the manifest left alone. CONSEQUENCE: until FEAT-002 rewrites those 4 values, the packaged plug-in is functionally broken - the manifest names three classes that no longer exist (they are now de.hock.mqtt.template.MqttConnectedSystemTemplate, de.hock.mqtt.integration.MqttPublishIntegration, de.hock.mqtt.integration.MqttSubscribeIntegration). FEAT-002 must do this first. Note also that docs/mqtt-plugin-guide.md and info.md contained ZERO occurrences of the old package, so nothing was needed there.

FOR FEAT-003: the final compliance grep should be scoped per DD-7 (src/, pom.xml, docs/, info.md, .kiro/, repo root; excluding target/ and .agents/). target/ currently holds freshly compiled classes under target/classes/de/hock/mqtt/ from the `mvn clean test` run; no package jar was built in this FEAT.
